SOCIAL STUDIES — TERMLY EXAM #13
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: SOCIAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Littering in markets
   B. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   C. Destroying road signs
   D. Avoiding all community work

2. Which statement about Main physical features in Eastern Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Main physical features in Eastern Africa as rumours only.
   B. Explain Main physical features in Eastern Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Main physical features in Eastern Africa never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Main physical features in Eastern Africa.

3. Which statement about Position and Size of Countries in Eastern Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)

   D. Skip evidence when discussing Position and Size of Countries in Eastern Africa.

7. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Measure rainfall only
   B. Name the president
   C. Replace the compass rose
   D. Explain symbols used on a map

8. Which statement about Vegetation in Eastern Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Vegetation in Eastern Africa.
